name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0
description: The NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0 provides a taxonomy of high-level cybersecurity outcomes to help organizations manage and reduce their cybersecurity risks.

functions.name: GOVERN
functions.description: The Govern Function provides outcomes to inform what an organization may do to achieve and prioritize the outcomes of the other five Functions in the context of its mission and stakeholder expectations.

functions.name: IDENTIFY
functions.description: The Identify Function helps determine the current cybersecurity risk to the organization.

functions.name: PROTECT
functions.description: The Protect Function covers the appropriate safeguards to ensure delivery of critical infrastructure services.

functions.name: DETECT
functions.description: The Detect Function defines the appropriate activities to identify the occurrence of a cybersecurity event.

functions.name: RESPOND
functions.description: The Respond Function includes appropriate activities to take action regarding a detected cybersecurity incident.

functions.name: RECOVER
functions.description: The Recover Function identifies appropriate activities to maintain plans for resilience and to restore any capabilities or services that were impaired due to a cybersecurity incident.

controls.title: Organizational Context
controls.description: The organizational mission is understood and informs cybersecurity risk management
controls.guidance: Understanding the organization's mission, strategy, and objectives is fundamental to understanding the organization's cybersecurity risk.

controls.title: Internal Stakeholders
controls.description: Internal stakeholders understand and communicate their roles and responsibilities regarding cybersecurity risk management
controls.guidance: Stakeholder roles should be clearly defined and communicated.

controls.title: Legal and Regulatory Requirements
controls.description: Legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements regarding cybersecurity are understood and managed
controls.guidance: Organizations should identify and document applicable requirements.

controls.title: Critical Objectives
controls.description: Critical objectives, capabilities, and services that stakeholders depend on are understood and communicated

controls.title: Dependencies and Critical Functions
controls.description: Outcomes, capabilities, and services that the organization depends on are understood and communicated
controls.guidance: Map dependencies between systems and services.

controls.title: Risk Management Strategy
controls.description: Risk management objectives are established and agreed upon by organizational stakeholders
controls.guidance: Document risk appetite and tolerance levels.

controls.title: Risk Appetite
controls.description: Risk appetite and risk tolerance statements are established, communicated, and maintained
controls.guidance: Define acceptable risk levels for the organization.

controls.title: Strategic Risk Decisions
controls.description: Cybersecurity risk management activities and outcomes are included in enterprise risk management processes
controls.guidance: Integrate cybersecurity into overall risk management.

controls.title: Communicate Strategic Direction
controls.description: Strategic direction that describes appropriate risk response options is established and communicated
controls.guidance: Provide guidance on risk response strategies.

controls.title: Roles and Responsibilities
controls.description: Organizational leadership is responsible and accountable for cybersecurity risk and fosters a culture of cybersecurity risk management

controls.title: Coordination
controls.description: Roles, responsibilities, and authorities related to cybersecurity risk management are established, communicated, understood, and enforced
controls.guidance: Document roles in policies and procedures.

controls.title: Resources
controls.description: Adequate resources are allocated commensurate with the cybersecurity risk strategy, roles, responsibilities, and policies

controls.title: Cybersecurity Integrated
controls.description: Cybersecurity is included in human resources practices
controls.guidance: Include security in hiring, training, and termination.

controls.title: Cybersecurity Policy
controls.description: Policy for managing cybersecurity risks is established based on organizational context, cybersecurity strategy, and priorities

controls.title: Policy Review
controls.description: Policy for managing cybersecurity risks is reviewed, updated, communicated, and enforced to reflect changes
controls.guidance: Review policies regularly and update as needed.

controls.title: Supplier Risk Management
controls.description: A cybersecurity supply chain risk management program is established, reviewed, and updated

controls.title: Supplier Due Diligence
controls.description: Cybersecurity supply chain risk management practices are integrated into the organization's overall risk management processes

controls.title: Hardware Inventory
controls.description: Inventories of hardware managed by the organization are maintained

controls.title: Software Inventory
controls.description: Inventories of software, services, and systems managed by the organization are maintained

controls.title: Data Flow
controls.description: Representations of the organization's authorized network communication and internal and external network data flows are maintained

controls.title: External Services
controls.description: Inventories of services provided by suppliers are maintained

controls.title: Asset Prioritization
controls.description: Assets are prioritized based on classification, criticality, resources, and impact to the mission
controls.guidance: Classify and prioritize assets by risk.

controls.title: Vulnerability Identification
controls.description: Vulnerabilities in assets are identified, validated, and recorded

controls.title: Threat Intelligence
controls.description: Cyber threat intelligence is received from information sharing forums and sources

controls.title: Threat Identification
controls.description: Internal and external threats to the organization are identified and recorded

controls.title: Risk Impact
controls.description: Potential impacts and likelihoods of threats exploiting vulnerabilities are identified and recorded

controls.title: Risk Determination
controls.description: Threats, vulnerabilities, likelihoods, and impacts are used to understand inherent risk and inform risk response prioritization

controls.title: Risk Response
controls.description: Risk responses are chosen, prioritized, planned, tracked, and communicated

controls.title: Risk Monitoring
controls.description: Changes and exceptions are managed, assessed for risk impact, recorded, and tracked
controls.guidance: Monitor for changes in risk posture.

controls.title: Improvement - Lessons Learned
controls.description: Improvements are identified from evaluations

controls.title: Improvement - Response Plans
controls.description: Improvements are identified from security tests and exercises
controls.guidance: Update response plans based on exercises.

controls.title: Identity Management
controls.description: Identities and credentials for authorized users, services, and hardware are managed by the organization

controls.title: Authentication
controls.description: Identities are proofed and bound to credentials based on the context of interactions

controls.title: User Access
controls.description: Users, services, and hardware are authenticated

controls.title: Identity Assertions
controls.description: Identity assertions are protected, conveyed, and verified

controls.title: Access Permissions
controls.description: Access permissions, entitlements, and authorizations are defined in a policy, managed, enforced, and reviewed

controls.title: Least Privilege
controls.description: Physical and logical access to assets is managed, monitored, and enforced commensurate with the risk to assets

controls.title: Security Awareness
controls.description: Personnel are provided with awareness and training

controls.title: Role-Based Training
controls.description: Individuals in specialized roles are provided with awareness and training

controls.title: Data Protection
controls.description: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-at-rest are protected

controls.title: Data-in-Transit
controls.description: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-transit are protected
controls.guidance: Use TLS for data in transit.

controls.title: Configuration Baselines
controls.description: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-use are protected

controls.title: Backup
controls.description: Data backups are created, protected, maintained, and tested

controls.title: Configuration Management
controls.description: Configuration management practices are established and applied

controls.title: Software Maintenance
controls.description: Software is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk

controls.title: Hardware Maintenance
controls.description: Hardware is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk

controls.title: Log Management
controls.description: Log records are generated and made available for continuous monitoring

controls.title: Secure Development
controls.description: Installation and execution of unauthorized software are prevented

controls.title: Secure SDLC
controls.description: Secure software development practices are integrated and followed

controls.title: Network Integrity
controls.description: Networks and environments are protected from unauthorized logical access and usage

controls.title: Technology Architecture
controls.description: The organization's technology assets are protected from environmental threats

controls.title: Continuous Monitoring - Network
controls.description: Networks and network services are monitored to find potentially adverse events

controls.title: Continuous Monitoring - Physical
controls.description: The physical environment is monitored to find potentially adverse events

controls.title: Continuous Monitoring - Personnel
controls.description: Personnel activity and technology usage are monitored to find potentially adverse events

controls.title: Continuous Monitoring - External
controls.description: External service provider activities and services are monitored to find potentially adverse events

controls.title: Malware Detection
controls.description: Computing hardware, software, runtime environments, and their data are monitored to find potentially adverse events

controls.title: Event Correlation
controls.description: Potentially adverse events are analyzed to better understand associated activities

controls.title: Event Aggregation
controls.description: Information is correlated from multiple sources

controls.title: Impact Analysis
controls.description: The estimated impact and scope of adverse events are understood

controls.title: Incident Declaration
controls.description: Information on adverse events is provided to authorized staff and tools

controls.title: Threat Intelligence Integration
controls.description: Cyber threat intelligence and other contextual information are integrated into the analysis

controls.title: Triage
controls.description: Incidents are declared when adverse events meet defined incident criteria

controls.title: Incident Management Plan
controls.description: The incident response plan is executed in coordination with relevant third parties

controls.title: Incident Tracking
controls.description: Incident reports are triaged and validated

controls.title: Incident Categorization
controls.description: Incidents are categorized and prioritized

controls.title: Incident Escalation
controls.description: Incidents are escalated or elevated as needed

controls.title: Forensics
controls.description: The criteria for initiating incident recovery are applied

controls.title: Root Cause Analysis
controls.description: Analysis is performed to establish what has taken place during an incident and the root cause

controls.title: Impact Understanding
controls.description: Actions performed during an investigation are recorded

controls.title: Artifact Collection
controls.description: Incident data and metadata are collected and their integrity and provenance are preserved

controls.title: Attribution
controls.description: An incident's magnitude is estimated and validated

controls.title: Internal Communication
controls.description: Internal and external stakeholders are notified of incidents

controls.title: External Communication
controls.description: Information is shared with designated internal and external parties

controls.title: Containment
controls.description: Incidents are contained

controls.title: Eradication
controls.description: Incidents are eradicated

controls.title: Recovery Planning
controls.description: The recovery portion of the incident response plan is executed

controls.title: Recovery Prioritization
controls.description: Recovery actions are prioritized and performed

controls.title: Data Restoration
controls.description: The integrity of backups and other restoration assets is verified

controls.title: Critical Functions
controls.description: Critical mission functions and cybersecurity risk management are considered

controls.title: System Restoration
controls.description: The integrity of restored assets is verified

controls.title: Stakeholder Communication
controls.description: The end of incident recovery is declared based on criteria

controls.title: Post-Recovery Communication
controls.description: Recovery activities and progress are communicated to designated stakeholders

controls.title: Public Communication
controls.description: Public updates on incident recovery are shared using approved methods
